page.overview:
Who is Luke?

According to character designer Kaname Fujioka, Luke is set up to serve as the Ryu for the new generation of Street Fighter fans. He was designed to be a straightforward and easy-to-relate-with type of main character without a lot of "curveballs" in comparison to Ryu.

Luke's inclusion in Street Fighter V served as a teaser while he was being worked on in Street Fighter 6. His design was aged down slightly to portray his inexperience. Luke's unique V-Trigger mechanic, which replenishes over time but reduces upon taking damage, was inspired by the Drive Gauge system.

Unlike most characters in the series, Luke's English voice was recorded first.

Luke's admiration for his late father's self-sacrifice in a bombing prompts him to join the Special Forces in an effort to combat terrorism. However, after a friendly match with Guile, Luke remarks that serving did not grant him the satisfaction he desired. With the Colonel's encouragement, Luke decides to embark on his own journey in competitive fighting.
